name: Chou
story: A talented fighter with a heart of chivalry.

skills.name: Only Fast
skills.desc: After traveling 5 units, Chou deals 180% damage on his next Basic Attack (cannot Crit), briefly slows the target by 90% and reduces their Physical Defense by 10(+1*Hero Level) for 3s (up to 2 stacks).

skills.name: Jeet Kune Do
skills.desc: Chou strikes in the target direction, dealing 180 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. This skill can be cast 3 times before it goes on cooldown. On the 3rd cast, Chou also knocks enemies hit airborne. Hitting an enemy hero with the 3rd cast resets the cooldown of Shunpo.

skills.name: Shunpo
skills.desc: Chou charges in the target direction, gaining Control Immunity and a 200 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield.

skills.name: The Way of Dragon
skills.desc: Chou strikes a roundhouse kick at the target enemy hero, dealing them 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back. Cast the skill again to chase up the target, dealing a total of 480 (+240% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
